summary: Organize the Mac Inbox into All, Asks, Updates and Notices tabs

schema.detail: No daemon or generated-client contract changes.

rules.detail: Tabs filter the existing Inbox items without changing attention or human-review rules.

compatibility.detail: The Mac Inbox offers All, Asks, Updates and Notices tabs, with counts and category-specific empty states.

manual.detail: No migration or user action is required.

recovery.detail: Restore the prior app package pin to roll back; daemon state is unchanged.
